digest.component_or_area: code review system - review-phase-boundaries project criterion dogfood
propositions: Deploy advisory-only gerrit probe across four sequential patchsets to validate project-criterion execution end-to-end through the deployed bot's webhook-to-checkout-to-prompt path

Positive-control patchset establishes that the review-phase-boundaries criterion correctly emits no finding when the discovery/evidence refinement explicitly names instructed phase, assigned action, and owning phase
Historical severity-only patchset demonstrates criterion abstains due to stimulus limitation when directive lacks phase ownership context

RP-F2 predeclared FIRE-control patchset must produce project-attributed advisory finding with reviewer_id and criteria fields, pass-2 validity 1.0 and impact 0.36, and pass-3 decision advisory with threshold 0.90 and blocking disabled
